rows.note: Must-not-happen hit: the first generation after each chat switch carries the OTHER story's checkpoint lore. Aegis msg 2 (Vallie, first reply after leaving the adventurer chat) fired 'CP road-to-wendhope - Scene' + 'Cast - The Party' from Adolion Adventurer Checkpoints, and the prompt holds '[Scene state: the frontier road north to Wendhope, second day out...]' (payloads.jsonl:77); the reverse on switching back: adventurer msg 15 fired 'Cast - Aegis', 'Aegis - The Promotion Exam', 'CP aegis-the-tavern - Scene'. Only the first generation; later ones are clean. Otherwise isolated: aegis blackboard has no party_name/path, memory has no Iron Kettles, nobody mentions the other chat unprompted; Wendhope facts in aegis come from my own provocation (msg 4).

Plain switches (turn --chat) were quick and each chat came back unchanged (adventurer still The Journey North / road-to-wendhope with its own HUD, shots/016; aegis kept Advice Over Ale). Switching mid-reply could not be done: the harness opened the other chat through the origin group (fixed in v26-t1c-harness 61d09265), and with the fix ST itself refuses a group switch while a group is generating (openGroupById: !is_group_generating), so the cross-group mid-reply switch is not possible in the host. Plus the lore leak on the first reply after each switch (row 0).

Memory tab shows only this story (92 rows, no Iron Kettles, no road/carriage facts); it did not start empty only because of my own Wendhope question. But near-duplicate facts pile up: 'names on the C-rank exam list' is stored 4-5 times in different words (shots/025).

Homecoming -> Advice Over Ale needed a second commitment: the card's own line 'put our names down for the C-rank exam' (msg 1) was held x3 (flag turns.jsonl:8; same commit-guard gap as T1-4); 'We'll sit the exam' (msg 6) committed and the tavern arrived at msg 9. Tavern -> Market Street was on time (same reply, msg 19, background cityscape market). Stopped at 40 min in the market before the rivals beat.

Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Journey North
Wendhope lies two days north along the frontier road, and the talk on the way is the party's own.
Something is starting to stir.
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left The Wendhope Job behind and moved into The Journey North.
Open threads
The north road to Wendhope is strangely empty, and something on the road itself has drawn Belle and Dalan's attention.
Dalan's commitment to the Iron Kettles remains unconfirmed beyond meeting at the northern gate.
A riderless Sheridan-blue horse on the north road raises the question of what happened to its rider and whether it connects to Wendhope's silence.
Something is deliberately keeping travelers off the north road — no tracks from the last three carriages, and nothing has come back for them.
Something took the carriages but left their cargo behind — the party must learn what is stalking the north road and why it spares the goods.
The story so far
Max Nightriver signed the Adventurers' Guild register in Aegis City three days before the story began, holding a new badge but no party. At the Guild counter, Tobias, who knew Max by sight, quietly steered him toward safer work — the troll bridge or the Old Market rats — rather than the Wendhope posting, which offered more coin than a collapsed mine should be worth and was backed by Sheridan coin, suggesting the Sheridans feared it was more than a collapsed mine.
